digest.component_or_area: code-review gate dispatch and criteria routing
propositions: Project code-review criteria with non-empty applies_to are dispatched unconditionally regardless of changed files, rather than being gated by glob matching
The applies_to field is stored and retrievable from effective_routing but never validated at overlay load and never read during dispatch
Project criteria are appended to active_criteria based only on workflow round, not on whether changed files match the applies_to globs
applies_to lacks shape validation at overlay load, so malformed values silently narrow to empty list instead of failing loudly
Code-review dispatch has no counterpart to plan-review's project_trigger_fires gating mechanism that properly evaluates applies_to and applies_at
An empty applies_to for project criteria should mean always-on (ungated), while for built-in overlays it means escalation-only
